about: Barraka beach furniture and timber access. Map metres +x east, +z south; beach heights remain owned by seaside.ts.

boardwalk.name: Barraka weathered timber boardwalk
boardwalk.trust: Owner clarification and full originals IMG_2346/2347 put the green aisle on the northeast/left flank of actual Barraka 6364501UF1366S_part8 looking seaward, with planter, cooking boat and hut to its left. Candidate axis moved from the erroneous southwest run by [+1,-20] m. Native Esri pale NE-flank strip around (1510,829) to (1560,886) supplies approximate context, but can mix roof/facade edge and ground. Endpoints and 1.65m width remain estimates with several metres uncertainty; no <=2m placement approval. See docs/reviews/barraka-planter-placement. Raw camera coordinates retained; the old 25m GPS-error inference used the wrong aisle and is retracted. Hidden landward join and exact seaward continuation unresolved.

sign.name: BARRAKA BEACH two-tier white planted sign
sign.trust: White painted timber, two planted tiers, dark BARRAKA BEACH lettering and photo-left placement are supported by originals IMG_2346/2347 and owner clarification. Proposed anchor moved [+1,-20]m with the northeast aisle correction, retaining the local left-side relation; lettered face now looks inland across the shared aisle direction. Anchor, dimensions and foliage silhouette remain estimates, not independently measured <=2m placement. Open discrepancy and independent-review limitations are retained in docs/reviews/barraka-planter-placement.

seating.name: Thatched parasols and wooden cream-cushion loungers
seating.trust: IMG_2225 supports straw parasols and paired low wooden cream-cushion beds on the right of the aisle in IMG_2347. Three representative pairs follow the southwest seating patch visible on the aerial (not a complete seasonal row or count). Dimensions and individual positions are estimates. Blue/white plastic loungers on the other side in IMG_2223 are a different type and are not replaced by wooden beds.
